===== FILE: dark-roast-theme/scripts/build-cold-brew.js =====
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Deterministic Cold Brew generator: authored OKLCH seeds -> gamut-mapped sRGB.
//
// Cold Brew is the first positive-polarity (light) companion. Unlike the
// hand-picked hex companions (House Blend, Copper Roast), its palette is
// authored in perceptually-uniform OKLCH in src/variants/cold-brew.seeds.json
// and compiled to the standard hex variant registry (src/variants/cold-brew.json)
// here. sRGB gamut mapping is delegated to Culori (culorijs.org) so out-of-gamut
// seeds reduce chroma deterministically instead of clipping to arbitrary hex.
//
//   node scripts/build-cold-brew.js            # regenerate src/variants/cold-brew.json
//   node scripts/build-cold-brew.js --check     # fail if the registry is out of sync
//   node scripts/build-cold-brew.js --report    # print WCAG + chroma diagnostics
//
// WCAG 2.x contrast (mirrored by Culori's wcagContrast) is the shipping gate
// enforced by validate-themes.js. This script only compiles seeds -> hex.

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { clampChroma, formatHex, wcagContrast, wcagLuminance } from 'culori';

const ROOT = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const TOKENS_PATH = join(ROOT, 'src', 'tokens.json');
const SEEDS_PATH = join(ROOT, 'src', 'cold-brew.seeds.json');
const OUT_PATH = join(ROOT, 'src', 'variants', 'cold-brew.json');

const flags = new Set(process.argv.slice(2));
const CHECK = flags.has('--check');
const REPORT = flags.has('--report');

// Deterministic OKLCH([l,c,h]) -> #RRGGBB with sRGB gamut mapping.
// clampChroma holds lightness + hue fixed and reduces chroma until the color is
// representable in sRGB — the deterministic mapping the plan asks for.
function seedToHex(seed) {
  const [l, c, h] = seed;
  const mapped = clampChroma({ mode: 'oklch', l, c, h: c === 0 ? undefined : h }, 'oklch', 'rgb');
  return formatHex(mapped).toUpperCase();
}

function main() {
  const tokenBytes = readFileSync(TOKENS_PATH);
  const tokens = JSON.parse(tokenBytes.toString('utf8'));
  const fingerprint = `sha256:${createHash('sha256').update(tokenBytes).digest('hex')}`;
  const packageVersion = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'package.json'), 'utf8')).version;
  const seeds = JSON.parse(readFileSync(SEEDS_PATH, 'utf8'));

  const colors = {};
  for (const [name, seed] of Object.entries(seeds.seeds.colors)) colors[name] = seedToHex(seed);
  const platform = {};
  for (const [name, seed] of Object.entries(seeds.seeds.platform)) platform[name] = seedToHex(seed);

  // Standard variant registry shape (mirrors house-blend.json) plus the
  // light-polarity metadata: polarity, targets, sourceVersion. The base pin is
  // computed live so the registry always tracks the current Black Label source.
  const variant = {
    id: seeds.id,
    displayOrder: seeds.displayOrder,
    name: seeds.name,
    shortName: seeds.shortName,
    selector: seeds.selector,
    className: seeds.className,
    version: seeds.version,
    baseVersion: tokens.version,
    baseFingerprint: fingerprint,
    polarity: seeds.polarity,
    targets: seeds.targets,
    sourceVersion: packageVersion,
    description: seeds.description,
    intent: seeds.intent,
    colors,
    platform,
    quality: seeds.quality,
    textasticUuid: seeds.textasticUuid,
  };

  const serialized = JSON.stringify(variant, null, 2) + '\n';

  if (REPORT) {
    const surface = colors[variant.quality.contrastSurface];
    const canvas = colors.void;
    const min = variant.quality.minimumInformationalContrast;
    const informational = [
      'crema', 'warmWhite', 'bone', 'mocha', 'asparagus', 'amber', 'amberHot',
      'amberMuted', 'gold', 'brass', 'scarlet', 'burntSienna', 'teal', 'magenta',
      'harvest', 'olive',
    ];
    const platformInfo = ['structural', 'sage', 'slate', 'mauve'];
    const surfaceScale = ['void', 'obsidian', 'darkCacao', 'espresso', 'espressoHover', 'roastedBean', 'crater'];
    const borderScale = ['roastedBean', 'craterDeep', 'crater'];
    console.error(`\nCold Brew report (contrastSurface=${variant.quality.contrastSurface} ${surface}, canvas ${canvas})`);
    console.error('  surface ramp (must strictly DECREASE for light polarity):');
    for (const key of surfaceScale) console.error(`    ${key.padEnd(14)} ${colors[key]}  Y=${wcagLuminance(colors[key]).toFixed(4)}`);
    console.error('  border ramp (must strictly DECREASE):');
    for (const key of borderScale) console.error(`    ${key.padEnd(14)} ${colors[key]}  Y=${wcagLuminance(colors[key]).toFixed(4)}`);
    console.error(`  informational contrast vs ${variant.quality.contrastSurface} (need >= ${min}):`);
    for (const key of [...informational, ...platformInfo]) {
      const value = key in colors ? colors[key] : platform[key];
      const ratio = wcagContrast(value, surface);
      console.error(`    ${key.padEnd(14)} ${value}  ${ratio.toFixed(2)}:1${ratio < min ? '  BELOW' : ''}`);
    }
    console.error('  action contrast vs void canvas (need >= 4.5):');
    for (const key of ['amber', 'teal', 'scarlet']) {
      const ratio = wcagContrast(colors[key], canvas);
      console.error(`    ${key.padEnd(14)} ${colors[key]}  ${ratio.toFixed(2)}:1${ratio < 4.5 ? '  BELOW' : ''}`);
    }
  }

  if (CHECK) {
    let current = null;
    try { current = readFileSync(OUT_PATH, 'utf8'); } catch {}
    if (current !== serialized) {
      console.error('✗ stale: src/variants/cold-brew.json (run `npm run build:cold-brew`)');
      process.exit(1);
    }
    console.log('✓ cold-brew.json in sync with OKLCH seeds');
    return;
  }

  writeFileSync(OUT_PATH, serialized);
  console.log(`✓ wrote src/variants/cold-brew.json (${Object.keys(colors).length} colors, ${Object.keys(platform).length} platform)`);
}

main();


===== FILE: dark-roast-theme/scripts/build-tokens.js =====
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Dark Roast: Black Label — token generator.
//
// Reads the single source of truth (src/tokens.json) and regenerates every
// derived file: the JS token modules (dist/tokens/*.js) and the CSS custom-
// property region injected into the hand-authored templates (src/css-templates/
// *.css → dist/css/*.css).
//
//   node scripts/build-tokens.js          # write generated files
//   node scripts/build-tokens.js --check  # exit 1 if any output is stale
//
// No runtime dependencies. The package still ships plain source files — this
// runs at dev time only, never at install.

import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';

const ROOT = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const SRC = join(ROOT, 'src', 'tokens.json');
const TEMPLATE_DIR = join(ROOT, 'src', 'css-templates');
const DIST_CSS = join(ROOT, 'dist', 'css');
const DIST_JS = join(ROOT, 'dist', 'tokens');

const t = JSON.parse(readFileSync(SRC, 'utf8'));

const BANNER = [
  '// AUTO-GENERATED from src/tokens.json by scripts/build-tokens.js — DO NOT EDIT.',
  '// Edit src/tokens.json and run `npm run build`.',
].join('\n');

const CSS_MARKER_START = '/* @generated:tokens — from src/tokens.json, do not edit by hand */';
const CSS_MARKER_END = '/* @end:tokens */';

// ── helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
const isMeta = (k) => k.startsWith('_');
const entries = (o) => Object.entries(o).filter(([k]) => !isMeta(k));

function hexToRgb(hex) {
  const h = hex.replace('#', '');
  return [0, 2, 4].map((i) => parseInt(h.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
}
// Minimal, consistent number formatting (0.40 → 0.4, 0.05 → 0.05).
const num = (n) => String(Number(n));
function rgba(hexOrToken, alpha) {
  const hex = hexOrToken.startsWith('#') ? hexOrToken : t.colors[hexOrToken];
  const [r, g, b] = hexToRgb(hex);
  return `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, ${num(alpha)})`;
}
const pascal = (s) => s.replace(/(^|[-_ ])(\w)/g, (_, __, c) => c.toUpperCase());
const kebab = (s) =>
  s.replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, '$1-$2').replace(/[._ ]/g, '-').toLowerCase();
// JS identifier-safe form of a scale key: '0.5' → '0_5', '2xl' stays '2xl'.
const idKey = (k) => k.replace(/\./g, '_');
const q = (v) => `'${v}'`;

// Which colors carry dim/subtle/ghost variants, and the tier alphas.
const VARIANT_COLORS = t._build.opacityVariantColors;
const TIERS = t._build.opacityTiers; // { dim, subtle, ghost }

// Render a glow's layers to a box-shadow value. `sep` joins layers.
function glowValue(layers, sep) {
  return layers
    .map(([blur, color, alpha]) => `0 0 ${blur}px ${rgba(color, alpha)}`)
    .join(sep);
}

// Color grouping, driven by the `_`-prefixed section markers in tokens.json so
// ordering and comments stay in lockstep with the source.
function colorGroups() {
  const groups = [];
  let cur = null;
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(t.colors)) {
    if (isMeta(k)) {
      cur = { marker: k, label: v, items: [] };
      groups.push(cur);
    } else if (cur) {
      cur.items.push([k, v]);
    }
  }
  return groups;
}

// ── JS: colors.js ───────────────────────────────────────────
function buildColorsJs() {
  const L = [BANNER, '// Color tokens: surface scale, foregrounds, accents, action colors,', '// severity hues, opacity variants, semantic roles.', ''];
  const jsName = (k) => (k === 'void' ? 'void_' : k);

  for (const g of colorGroups()) {
    L.push(`// ── ${g.label} ──`);
    for (const [k, v] of g.items) L.push(`export const ${jsName(k)} = '${v}';`);
    L.push('');
  }

  L.push('// ── Opacity Variants (dim 40% / subtle 10% / ghost 5%) ──');
  for (const c of VARIANT_COLORS) {
    for (const [tier, a] of Object.entries(TIERS)) {
      L.push(`export const ${c}${pascal(tier)} = '${rgba(c, a)}';`);
    }
  }
  L.push('');
  L.push('// ── Structural derived ──');
  L.push(`export const divider = '${rgba(t._build.divider.color, t._build.divider.alpha)}';`);
  L.push('');

  L.push('// ── Semantic Roles (pointers into primitives) ──');
  const colorRoles = entries(t.roles).filter(([, v]) => typeof v === 'string' && t.colors[v] !== undefined);
  // accent..live alias primitives by name; display/workhorse/secondary/tertiary handled in objects below.
  const ALIAS_ROLES = ['accent', 'accentHot', 'accentMuted', 'success', 'warning', 'error', 'critical', 'stable', 'live'];
  for (const r of ALIAS_ROLES) L.push(`export const ${r} = ${jsName(t.roles[r])};`);
  L.push('');

  // colors{} object — grouped in source order.
  L.push('export const colors = {');
  for (const g of colorGroups()) {
    for (const [k] of g.items) L.push(`  ${k === 'void' ? 'void: void_' : k},`);
  }
  L.push('};');
  L.push('');

  L.push('export const roles = {');
  for (const r of ALIAS_ROLES) L.push(`  ${r},`);
  for (const [r, v] of entries(t.roles)) {
    if (!ALIAS_ROLES.includes(r)) L.push(`  ${r}: ${jsName(v)},`);
  }
  L.push('};');
  L.push('');

  L.push('export const opacityVariants = {');
  for (const c of VARIANT_COLORS) {
    L.push('  ' + Object.keys(TIERS).map((tier) => `${c}${pascal(tier)}`).join(', ') + ',');
  }
  L.push('  divider,');
  L.push('};');
  L.push('');

  L.push('export const opacityScale = {');
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.opacity)) L.push(`  ${k}: ${num(v.decimal)},`);
  L.push('};');

  return L.join('\n') + '\n';
}

// ── JS: glows.js ────────────────────────────────────────────
function buildGlowsJs() {
  const L = [BANNER, '// Multi-layer phosphor box-shadow values. NOT colors.', ''];
  for (const [k, g] of entries(t.glows)) {
    // Each layer carries a trailing ", " (except the last) so the concatenated
    // string is a valid comma-separated box-shadow.
    const last = g.layers.length - 1;
    const body = g.layers
      .map(([b, c, a], i) => `'0 0 ${b}px ${rgba(c, a)}${i < last ? ', ' : ''}'`)
      .join(' +\n  ');
    L.push(`export const glow${pascal(k)} =\n  ${body};`);
  }
  L.push('');
  // Glass gradient: var() form (CSS context) + hex-resolved form (JS use).
  const gl = t.gradients.glass;
  const toRgba = rgba(gl.to, gl.toAlpha);
  L.push(`export const glassGradientCSS = 'linear-gradient(${gl.angle}, var(--dr-${kebab(gl.from)}), ${toRgba})';`);
  L.push(`export const glassGradient = 'linear-gradient(${gl.angle}, ${t.colors[gl.from]}, ${toRgba})';`);
  L.push('');
  L.push('export const glows = {');
  for (const [k] of entries(t.glows)) L.push(`  ${k}: glow${pascal(k)},`);
  L.push('};');
  return L.join('\n') + '\n';
}

// ── JS: typography.js ───────────────────────────────────────
function buildTypographyJs() {
  const L = [BANNER, '// Font stacks, type scale, letter-spacing, semantic roles.', ''];
  const fam = t.typography.families;
  const stack = (f) => `'${fam[f].family}', ${fam[f].fallback}`;
  L.push('// ── Font Stacks ──');
  for (const f of Object.keys(fam).filter((k) => !isMeta(k))) {
    L.push(`export const font${pascal(f)} = "${stack(f)}";`);
  }
  L.push('');
  L.push('// ── Type Scale ──');
  for (const [k, s] of entries(t.typography.scale)) {
    L.push(
      `export const text${pascal(k)} = { size: '${s.sizePx}px', rem: '${s.sizeRem}', ` +
        `lineHeight: ${num(s.lineHeight)}, tracking: '${s.letterSpacing}', weight: ${s.weight} };`,
    );
  }
  L.push('');
  L.push('// ── Legacy v3 rem-only size tokens ──');
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.typography._legacyRem)) L.push(`export const ${k} = '${v}';`);
  L.push('');
  L.push('// ── Letter Spacing ──');
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.typography.tracking)) L.push(`export const tracking${pascal(k)} = '${v}';`);
  L.push('');
  L.push('// ── Semantic Typography Roles ──');
  L.push('export const typographyRoles = ' + jsObject(t.typography.roles, 0) + ';');
  L.push('');
  L.push('export const fontStacks = {');
  for (const f of Object.keys(fam).filter((k) => !isMeta(k))) L.push(`  ${f}: font${pascal(f)},`);
  L.push('};');
  L.push('');
  L.push('export const typeScale = {');
  for (const [k] of entries(t.typography.scale)) L.push(`  ${q(k)}: text${pascal(k)},`);
  L.push('};');
  L.push('');
  L.push('export const tracking = {');
  for (const [k] of entries(t.typography.tracking)) L.push(`  ${k}: tracking${pascal(k)},`);
  L.push('};');
  return L.join('\n') + '\n';
}

// Render a plain JSON object/value as a JS literal (objects only need string/number/nested).
function jsObject(o, indent) {
  const pad = '  '.repeat(indent + 1);
  const close = '  '.repeat(indent);
  const lines = entries(o).map(([k, v]) => {
    const key = /^[a-zA-Z_$][\w$]*$/.test(k) ? k : q(k);
    if (v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v)) return `${pad}${key}: ${jsObject(v, indent + 1)}`;
    const val = typeof v === 'number' ? num(v) : q(v);
    return `${pad}${key}: ${val}`;
  });
  return `{\n${lines.join(',\n')},\n${close}}`;
}

// ── JS: spacing.js ──────────────────────────────────────────
function buildSpacingJs() {
  const L = [BANNER, '// Spacing, radii, motion, z-index, icon, elevation.', ''];

  // Numeric keys stay numeric (space0, space1_5); the lone alpha key `px` is
  // PascalCased to spacePx.
  const spaceConst = (k) => 'space' + (/^[a-z]/.test(k) ? pascal(k) : idKey(k));
  L.push('// ── Spacing Scale (4px base) ──');
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.spacing.scale)) L.push(`export const ${spaceConst(k)} = '${v}';`);
  L.push('');
  L.push('// ── Spacing Aliases ──');
  for (const [a, ref] of entries(t.spacing.aliases)) L.push(`export const space${pascal(a)} = ${spaceConst(ref)};`);
  L.push('');

  L.push('// ── Border Radii ──');
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.radii)) L.push(`export const radius${pascal(k)} = '${v}';`);
  L.push('');

  L.push('// ── Geo-Stripe ──');
  L.push(`export const stripeHeight = '${t.stripe.height}';`);
  L.push(`export const stripeOpacity = '${num(t.stripe.opacity)}';`);
  L.push('');

  L.push('// ── Durations ──');
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.motion.durations)) L.push(`export const duration${pascal(k)} = '${v}';`);
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.motion._legacyDurations)) L.push(`export const duration${pascal(k)} = '${v}';`);
  L.push('');

  L.push('// ── Easings ──');
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.motion.easings)) {
    if (k === 'default') L.push(`export const easing = '${v}';`);
    else if (k.startsWith('swiftui')) L.push(`export const ${k} = '${v}';`);
    else L.push(`export const easing${pascal(k)} = '${v}';`);
  }
  L.push('');

  L.push('// ── Z-Index ──');
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.zIndex)) L.push(`export const z${pascal(k)} = ${num(v)};`);
  L.push('');

  L.push('// ── Icon Sizes ──');
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.icon.size)) L.push(`export const icon${pascal(k)} = '${v}';`);
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.icon.strokeWidth)) L.push(`export const iconStroke${pascal(k)} = ${num(v)};`);
  L.push('');

  L.push('// ── Elevation ──');
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.elevation)) L.push(`export const elevation${pascal(k)} = ${jsObject(v, 0)};`);
  L.push('');

  // Collected objects.
  L.push('export const spacing = {');
  for (const [k] of entries(t.spacing.scale)) L.push(`  ${q(k)}: ${spaceConst(k)},`);
  for (const [a] of entries(t.spacing.aliases)) L.push(`  ${q(a)}: space${pascal(a)},`);
  L.push('};');
  L.push('');
  L.push('export const radii = {');
  for (const [k] of entries(t.radii)) L.push(`  ${q(k)}: radius${pascal(k)},`);
  L.push('};');
  L.push('');
  L.push('export const durations = {');
  for (const [k] of entries(t.motion.durations)) L.push(`  ${k}: duration${pascal(k)},`);
  for (const [k] of entries(t.motion._legacyDurations)) L.push(`  ${k}: duration${pascal(k)},`);
  L.push('};');
  L.push('');
  L.push('export const easings = {');
  for (const [k] of entries(t.motion.easings)) {
    const ref = k === 'default' ? 'easing' : k.startsWith('swiftui') ? k : `easing${pascal(k)}`;
    L.push(`  ${k === 'default' ? 'default: easing' : `${k}: ${ref}`},`);
  }
  L.push('};');
  L.push('');
  L.push('export const zIndex = {');
  for (const [k] of entries(t.zIndex)) L.push(`  ${k}: z${pascal(k)},`);
  L.push('};');
  L.push('');
  L.push('export const icon = {');
  L.push('  size: {');
  for (const [k] of entries(t.icon.size)) L.push(`    ${q(k)}: icon${pascal(k)},`);
  L.push('  },');
  L.push('  stroke: {');
  for (const [k] of entries(t.icon.strokeWidth)) L.push(`    ${k}: iconStroke${pascal(k)},`);
  L.push('  },');
  L.push('};');
  L.push('');
  L.push('export const elevation = {');
  for (const [k] of entries(t.elevation)) L.push(`  ${k}: elevation${pascal(k)},`);
  L.push('};');
  return L.join('\n') + '\n';
}

function buildIndexJs() {
  return [BANNER, '', "export * from './colors.js';", "export * from './typography.js';", "export * from './glows.js';", "export * from './spacing.js';", ''].join('\n');
}

// ── CSS: the @generated token region (shared by both templates) ──
function buildCssVars() {
  const I = '    ';
  const L = [];
  const decl = (name, val) => L.push(`${I}--dr-${name}: ${val};`);

  // Primitives, grouped.
  for (const g of colorGroups()) {
    L.push(`${I}/* ${g.label} */`);
    for (const [k, v] of g.items) decl(kebab(k), v);
    L.push('');
  }

  // Semantic role aliases.
  L.push(`${I}/* Semantic role aliases */`);
  const ALIAS_ROLES = ['accent', 'accentHot', 'accentMuted', 'success', 'warning', 'error', 'critical', 'stable', 'live'];
  for (const r of ALIAS_ROLES) decl(kebab(r), `var(--dr-${kebab(t.roles[r])})`);
  for (const r of ['display', 'workhorse', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'body', 'muted']) decl(`fg-${r}`, `var(--dr-${kebab(t.roles[r])})`);
  L.push('');

  // Opacity variants.
  L.push(`${I}/* Opacity variants (dim 40% / subtle 10% / ghost 5%) */`);
  for (const c of VARIANT_COLORS) {
    for (const [tier, a] of Object.entries(TIERS)) decl(`${kebab(c)}-${tier}`, rgba(c, a));
  }
  decl('divider', rgba(t._build.divider.color, t._build.divider.alpha));
  L.push('');

  // Glows (multi-line for readability).
  L.push(`${I}/* Glow effects — white hotspot / color midband / color wash */`);
  for (const [k, g] of entries(t.glows)) {
    const body = g.layers.map(([b, c, a]) => `${I}${I}0 0 ${b}px ${rgba(c, a)}`).join(',\n');
    L.push(`${I}--dr-glow-${kebab(k)}:\n${body};`);
  }
  const gl = t.gradients.glass;
  decl('glass-gradient', `linear-gradient(${gl.angle}, var(--dr-${kebab(gl.from)}), ${rgba(gl.to, gl.toAlpha)})`);
  L.push('');

  // Elevation.
  L.push(`${I}/* Elevation — shadow + border pairs */`);
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.elevation)) {
    decl(`elevation-${kebab(k)}-shadow`, v.shadow);
    decl(`elevation-${kebab(k)}-border`, v.border);
  }
  L.push('');

  // Typography.
  L.push(`${I}/* Typography */`);
  const fam = t.typography.families;
  for (const f of Object.keys(fam).filter((k) => !isMeta(k))) decl(`font-${kebab(f)}`, `'${fam[f].family}', ${fam[f].fallback}`);
  for (const [k, s] of entries(t.typography.scale)) decl(`text-${kebab(k)}`, s.sizeRem);
  decl('text-huge', t.typography._legacyRem.textHuge);
  for (const [k, s] of entries(t.typography.scale)) decl(`leading-${kebab(k)}`, num(s.lineHeight));
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.typography.tracking)) decl(`tracking-${kebab(k)}`, v);
  L.push('');

  // Spacing & geometry.
  L.push(`${I}/* Spacing (4px base) */`);
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.spacing.scale)) decl(`space-${kebab(k)}`, v);
  for (const [a, ref] of entries(t.spacing.aliases)) decl(`space-${kebab(a)}`, `var(--dr-space-${kebab(ref)})`);
  L.push('');
  L.push(`${I}/* Border radii */`);
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.radii)) decl(`radius-${kebab(k)}`, v);
  L.push('');
  L.push(`${I}/* Geo stripe */`);
  decl('stripe-height', t.stripe.height);
  decl('stripe-opacity', num(t.stripe.opacity));
  L.push('');
  L.push(`${I}/* Icon sizes */`);
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.icon.size)) decl(`icon-${kebab(k)}`, v);
  L.push('');

  // Motion.
  L.push(`${I}/* Motion — durations + easings */`);
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.motion.durations)) decl(`duration-${kebab(k)}`, v);
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.motion._legacyDurations)) decl(`duration-${kebab(k)}`, v);
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.motion.easings)) {
    if (k.startsWith('swiftui')) continue; // native-only
    decl(k === 'default' ? 'easing' : `easing-${kebab(k)}`, v);
  }
  L.push('');

  // Z-index.
  L.push(`${I}/* Z-index scale */`);
  for (const [k, v] of entries(t.zIndex)) decl(`z-${kebab(k)}`, num(v));

  return L.join('\n');
}

function injectCss(template, region) {
  const s = template.indexOf(CSS_MARKER_START);
  const e = template.indexOf(CSS_MARKER_END);
  if (s === -1 || e === -1) throw new Error(`CSS template missing @generated markers`);
  return template.slice(0, s + CSS_MARKER_START.length) + '\n' + region + '\n' + template.slice(e);
}

// ── orchestration ───────────────────────────────────────────
const outputs = [
  [join(DIST_JS, 'colors.js'), buildColorsJs()],
  [join(DIST_JS, 'glows.js'), buildGlowsJs()],
  [join(DIST_JS, 'typography.js'), buildTypographyJs()],
  [join(DIST_JS, 'spacing.js'), buildSpacingJs()],
  [join(DIST_JS, 'index.js'), buildIndexJs()],
];

const cssRegion = buildCssVars();
for (const name of ['dark-roast.css', 'dark-roast-scoped.css']) {
  const template = readFileSync(join(TEMPLATE_DIR, name), 'utf8');
  outputs.push([join(DIST_CSS, name), injectCss(template, cssRegion)]);
}

const check = process.argv.includes('--check');
let stale = 0;
for (const [path, content] of outputs) {
  let current = null;
  try {
    current = readFileSync(path, 'utf8');
  } catch {}
  if (check) {
    if (current !== content) {
      stale++;
      console.error(`✗ stale: ${path.replace(ROOT + '/', '')}`);
    }
  } else {
    mkdirSync(dirname(path), { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(path, content);
    console.log(`✓ wrote ${path.replace(ROOT + '/', '')}`);
  }
}

if (check) {
  if (stale) {
    console.error(`\n${stale} file(s) out of sync with src/tokens.json. Run \`npm run build\`.`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log('✓ all generated files in sync with src/tokens.json');
}


===== FILE: dark-roast-theme/scripts/build-variants.js =====
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Dark Roast companion-theme generator.
//
// Black Label remains owned by src/tokens.json + build-tokens.js. This script
// reads that frozen baseline and the additive definitions in src/variants/, then
// emits independent CSS, JavaScript, editor, terminal, and native palette files.
//
//   node scripts/build-variants.js          # write companion outputs
//   node scripts/build-variants.js --check  # fail when committed outputs drift

import {
  mkdirSync,
  readFileSync,
  readdirSync,
  rmSync,
  rmdirSync,
  writeFileSync,
} from 'node:fs';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const ROOT = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const BASE_PATH = join(ROOT, 'src', 'tokens.json');
const VARIANTS_DIR = join(ROOT, 'src', 'variants');
const baseSource = readFileSync(BASE_PATH, 'utf8');
const base = JSON.parse(baseSource);
const packageVersion = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'package.json'), 'utf8')).version;
const baseFingerprint = `sha256:${createHash('sha256').update(baseSource).digest('hex')}`;
const variants = readdirSync(VARIANTS_DIR)
  .filter((name) => name.endsWith('.json'))
  .sort()
  .map((name) => JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(VARIANTS_DIR, name), 'utf8')))
  .sort((first, second) => first.displayOrder - second.displayOrder || first.id.localeCompare(second.id));

if (variants.some((variant) => !Number.isInteger(variant.displayOrder) || variant.displayOrder < 1)) {
  throw new Error('Every companion must declare a positive integer displayOrder');
}
if (new Set(variants.map((variant) => variant.displayOrder)).size !== variants.length) {
  throw new Error('Companion displayOrder values must be unique');
}

const BANNER = '/* AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/build-variants.js — DO NOT EDIT. */';
const JS_BANNER = '// AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/build-variants.js — DO NOT EDIT.';
const HASH_BANNER = '# AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/build-variants.js — DO NOT EDIT.';
const XML_BANNER = '<!-- AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/build-variants.js — DO NOT EDIT. -->';

const basePlatform = {
  sage: '#8AAC6B',
  slate: '#6E8FAD',
  mauve: '#AD7FA8',
  scarletBright: '#D46868',
  sageBright: '#A3C484',
  slateBright: '#8AABC4',
  mauveBright: '#C49BC0',
  tealBright: '#6DD4C8',
  tealActive: '#6ED8CA',
  shadow: '#0A0603',
  hoverSurface: '#1A0F09',
};

const outputs = [];
const check = process.argv.includes('--check');

// Target groups let a companion ship to a subset of platforms. A variant with
// no `targets` field ships everywhere (Black Label parity — House Blend and
// Copper Roast); a web-only companion like Cold Brew defers editor/native
// artifacts. Web outputs (CSS + ESM theme module + effective tokens) always
// generate, since every companion is at minimum a web theme.
const ALL_TARGETS = ['web', 'editor', 'terminal', 'native'];
const variantTargets = (variant) =>
  Array.isArray(variant.targets) && variant.targets.length ? variant.targets : ALL_TARGETS;
const hasTarget = (variant, group) => variantTargets(variant).includes(group);
const pushIf = (condition, entry) => { if (condition) outputs.push(entry); };
const hex = (value) => value.toUpperCase();
const rgb = (value) => [1, 3, 5].map((i) => Number.parseInt(value.slice(i, i + 2), 16));
const hexFromRgb = (r, g, b) =>
  '#' + [r, g, b].map((v) => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(v))).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('').toUpperCase();
const escapeRe = (value) => value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
const pascal = (value) => value.split('-').map((part) => part[0].toUpperCase() + part.slice(1)).join('');

function relativeLuminance(value) {
  const channels = rgb(value).map((channel) => {
    const normalized = channel / 255;
    return normalized <= 0.04045 ? normalized / 12.92 : ((normalized + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4;
  });
  return 0.2126 * channels[0] + 0.7152 * channels[1] + 0.0722 * channels[2];
}

function contrast(first, second) {
  const a = relativeLuminance(first);
  const b = relativeLuminance(second);
  return Number(((Math.max(a, b) + 0.05) / (Math.min(a, b) + 0.05)).toFixed(2));
}

function colorMapFor(variant, terminal = false) {
  const map = new Map();
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(base.colors)) {
    if (name.startsWith('_')) continue;
    map.set(hex(value), variant.colors[name]);
  }
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(basePlatform)) {
    map.set(hex(value), variant.platform[name]);
  }
  // ANSI bright black is informational foreground, not a geological border.
  if (terminal) map.set(hex(base.colors.craterDeep), variant.platform.structural);
  return map;
}

function replaceHexColors(source, map) {
  return source.replace(/#([0-9a-f]{6})([0-9a-f]{2})?/gi, (match, body, alpha = '') => {
    const replacement = map.get(`#${body.toUpperCase()}`);
    return replacement ? replacement + alpha.toUpperCase() : match;
  });
}

function replaceFunctionalColors(source, map) {
  return source.replace(/rgba?\(\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)\s*,\s*(\d+)(\s*,[^)]*)?\)/gi, (match, r, g, b, tail = '') => {
    const replacement = map.get(hexFromRgb(r, g, b));
    if (!replacement) return match;
    const [nr, ng, nb] = rgb(replacement);
    return `rgb${tail ? 'a' : ''}(${nr}, ${ng}, ${nb}${tail})`;
  });
}

function replaceColors(source, map) {
  return replaceFunctionalColors(replaceHexColors(source, map), map);
}

function renameTheme(source, variant) {
  const plainName = variant.name.replace(':', '');
  return source
    .replaceAll('DARK ROAST: BLACK LABEL', variant.name.toUpperCase())
    .replaceAll('Dark Roast: Black Label', variant.name)
    .replaceAll('Dark Roast Black Label', plainName)
    .replaceAll('Black Label', variant.shortName)
    .replaceAll('BLACK LABEL', variant.shortName.toUpperCase())
    .replace('Version: 4.0.0', 'Version: 5.1.0 Companion')
    .replace('Version: 2.0 (Canonical Overhaul)', 'Version: 5.1.0 Companion')
    .replace('Version: 2.0 (Canonical)', 'Version: 5.1.0 Companion')
    .replace('Version: 2.1', 'Version: 5.1.0 Companion');
}

function namespaceKeyframes(source, variant) {
  const names = [...source.matchAll(/@keyframes\s+(dr-[\w-]+)/g)].map((match) => match[1]);
  let result = source;
  for (const name of new Set(names)) {
    const replacement = `dr-${variant.id}-${name.slice(3)}`;
    result = result.replace(
      new RegExp(`(@keyframes\\s+)${escapeRe(name)}(?=\\s*\\{)`, 'g'),
      `$1${replacement}`,
    );
    // Namespace animation identifiers without renaming the public utility
    // classes that happen to share those identifiers (for example
    // `.dr-pulse-teal`). Every family member keeps the same component API.
    result = result.replace(/animation(?:-name)?\s*:[^;}]+/g, (declaration) =>
      declaration.replace(new RegExp(`(?<![-\\w])${escapeRe(name)}(?![-\\w])`, 'g'), replacement));
  }
  return result;
}

function normalizeCssCompanionComments(source, variant) {
  return source
    .replace(
      /   GENERATED FILE — do not edit\. Source: src\/tokens\.json \+ this template's\n   hand-authored regions\. Regenerate with `npm run build`\.\n\n   The :root token block below is filled by scripts\/build-tokens\.js between the\n   @generated markers\. Everything else \(app-layer vars, keyframes, utilities,\n   base styles\) is hand-authored in src\/css-templates\/\./,
      `   GENERATED FILE — do not edit. Source: src/variants/${variant.id}.json\n` +
      '   plus the Black Label CSS templates. Regenerate with `npm run build:variants`.\n\n' +
      '   scripts/build-variants.js owns the palette transform, keyframe namespace,\n' +
      '   and companion quality layer; shared component structure comes from\n' +
      '   src/css-templates/.'
    )
    .replace('/* @generated:tokens — from src/tokens.json, do not edit by hand */', `/* @generated:tokens — from src/variants/${variant.id}.json, do not edit by hand */`)
    .replace(
      /\/\* Clinical severity primitives \(Option C, v4\.1\.0\)\. Distinct hue families[^*]*\*\//,
      '/* Directional severity uses distinct hue families plus required iconography; color is category, icon is direction. */',
    )
    .replace('Activated by adding class="dark-roast" to body (or any container).', `Activated by adding class="${variant.className}" to body (or any container).`);
}

function addVariantCssPolish(source, variant, scoped) {
  const scope = scoped ? `[data-theme="${variant.selector}"]` : `.${variant.className}`;
  const keyframe = `dr-${variant.id}-shimmer-skeleton`;
  const polish = `

/* Companion quality layer: informational structure, complete utilities. */
${scope} {
    --dr-structural: ${variant.platform.structural};
    --dr-fg-structural: var(--dr-structural);
}

${scope} .dr-shimmer-skeleton {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--dr-espresso) 0%, var(--dr-espresso-hover) 50%, var(--dr-espresso) 100%);
    background-size: 200% 100%;
    animation: ${keyframe} 1.5s linear infinite;
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    ${scope} .dr-shimmer-skeleton { animation: none; }
}

${scope} :is(.dr-severity-critical, .dr-severity-worsening, .dr-severity-improving, .dr-severity-stable, .dr-severity-resolved) {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: var(--dr-space-1-5);
    min-height: 28px;
    padding: var(--dr-space-1) var(--dr-space-2);
    border: 1px solid currentColor;
    border-radius: var(--dr-radius-full);
    font-family: var(--dr-font-body);
    font-size: var(--dr-text-sm);
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1;
}
`;
  return source + polish;
}

function buildCssVariant(baseCss, variant, scoped) {
  let result = replaceColors(baseCss, colorMapFor(variant));
  const [ar, ag, ab] = rgb(variant.colors.amber);
  result = result.replace(
    /(::(?:-moz-)?selection\s*\{[\s\S]*?\bbackground:\s*)rgba\([^)]+\)/g,
    `$1rgba(${ar}, ${ag}, ${ab}, 0.22)`,
  );
  if (variant.polarity === 'light') {
    // Black Label's elevation borders, dividers, and glow hotspots are white at
    // low alpha, tuned for a dark canvas. On a positive-polarity companion they
    // would be invisible or inverted, so remap the neutral white overlay to the
    // companion's dark shadow tone — borders and separators then read on a
    // bright surface, and glows become soft dark halos instead of white ones.
    const [sr, sg, sb] = rgb(variant.platform.shadow);
    result = result.replace(
      /rgba\(\s*255\s*,\s*255\s*,\s*255\s*(,[^)]*)\)/g,
      `rgba(${sr}, ${sg}, ${sb}$1)`,
    );
  }
  result = renameTheme(result, variant);
  result = namespaceKeyframes(result, variant);
  result = normalizeCssCompanionComments(result, variant);
  if (scoped) {
    result = result.replaceAll('[data-theme="dark-roast"]', `[data-theme="${variant.selector}"]`);
    // The Black Label beachhead migration table contains fixed legacy values
    // and is documentation, not runtime CSS. Do not copy stale claims into a
    // companion stylesheet.
    result = result.replace(/\n\/\* ={20,}\n   SECTION 16:[\s\S]*$/, '\n');
  } else {
    result = result.replace(/\.dark-roast(?![\w-])/g, `.${variant.className}`);
  }
  return `${BANNER}\n${addVariantCssPolish(result, variant, scoped)}`;
}

function setJsoncValue(source, key, value) {
  const serialized = typeof value === 'string' ? `"${value}"` : JSON.stringify(value);
  const pattern = new RegExp(`("${escapeRe(key)}"\\s*:\\s*)(?:"#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6,8}"|\\{[^\\n]*\\})`);
  return source.replace(pattern, `$1${serialized}`);
}

function setNamedRule(source, namePrefix, foreground, fontStyle) {
  const nameAt = source.indexOf(`"name": "${namePrefix}`);
  if (nameAt === -1) return source;
  const end = source.indexOf('\n    },', nameAt);
  if (end === -1) return source;
  const before = source.slice(0, nameAt);
  let block = source.slice(nameAt, end);
  block = block.replace(/"foreground"\s*:\s*"#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6,8}"/, `"foreground": "${foreground}"`);
  if (fontStyle !== undefined) {
    if (/"fontStyle"\s*:/.test(block)) block = block.replace(/"fontStyle"\s*:\s*"[^"]*"/, `"fontStyle": "${fontStyle}"`);
    else block = block.replace(/("foreground"\s*:\s*"#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6,8}")/, `$1, "fontStyle": "${fontStyle}"`);
  }
  return before + block + source.slice(end);
}

function setTmThemeRule(source, namePrefix, foreground, fontStyle) {
  const nameAt = source.indexOf(`<string>${namePrefix}`);
  if (nameAt === -1) return source;
  const nextRule = source.indexOf('<key>name</key>', nameAt + namePrefix.length);
  const end = nextRule === -1 ? source.length : nextRule;
  let block = source.slice(nameAt, end);
  block = block.replace(/(<key>foreground<\/key>\s*<string>)#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6,8}(<\/string>)/, `$1${foreground}$2`);
  // The Black Label source carries hand-authored token comments on the same
  // line as foreground values. A companion can intentionally remap that role,
  // so remove the inherited annotation instead of publishing a contradiction.
  block = block.replace(/(<key>foreground<\/key>\s*<string>#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6,8}<\/string>)\s*<!--[^\n]*-->/, '$1');
  if (fontStyle !== undefined) {
    if (/<key>fontStyle<\/key>/.test(block)) {
      block = block.replace(/(<key>fontStyle<\/key>\s*<string>)[^<]*(<\/string>)/, `$1${fontStyle}$2`);
    }
  }
  return source.slice(0, nameAt) + block + source.slice(end);
}

    "chat.requestBubbleBackground": "${c.espresso}",
    "chat.requestBubbleHoverBackground": "${c.espressoHover}",
    "chat.requestCodeBorder": "${c.roastedBean}",
    "chat.slashCommandBackground": "${c.amber}1A",
    "chat.slashCommandForeground": "${c.amber}",
    "chat.avatarBackground": "${c.espresso}",
    "chat.avatarForeground": "${c.crema}",
    "chat.editedFileForeground": "${p.slate}",
    "chat.linesAddedForeground": "${p.sage}",
    "chat.linesRemovedForeground": "${c.scarlet}",
    "chat.checkpointSeparator": "${c.roastedBean}",
    "chat.thinkingShimmer": "${c.teal}",
    "markdownAlert.note.foreground": "${p.slate}",
    "markdownAlert.tip.foreground": "${c.teal}",
    "markdownAlert.important.foreground": "${p.mauve}",
    "markdownAlert.warning.foreground": "${c.amber}",
    "markdownAlert.caution.foreground": "${c.scarlet}",
    "agentSessionReadIndicator.foreground": "${c.teal}",
    "agentSessionSelectedBadge.border": "${c.amber}",
    "agentSessionSelectedUnfocusedBadge.border": "${p.structural}",
    "agentStatusIndicator.background": "${c.teal}"`;
  const existingKeys = new Set([...source.matchAll(/^\s*"([^"]+)"\s*:/gm)].map((match) => match[1]));
  const newLines = modern.split('\n').filter((line) => {
    const match = line.match(/^\s*"([^"]+)"\s*:/);
    return !match || !existingKeys.has(match[1]);
  }).join('\n');
  const needle = `    "ports.iconRunningProcessForeground": "${c.teal}"\n  },`;
  return source.replace(needle, `    "ports.iconRunningProcessForeground": "${c.teal}",\n\n${newLines}\n  },`);
}

function buildVsCodeVariant(source, variant) {
  const c = variant.colors;
  const p = variant.platform;
  const paletteHeader = `  // Palette quick reference:
  //   void         ${c.void}   canvas
  //   obsidian     ${c.obsidian}   elevated floor
  //   dark-cacao   ${c.darkCacao}   sidebar / panel
  //   espresso     ${c.espresso}   window chrome
  //   espresso-hov ${c.espressoHover}   interaction lift
  //   roasted-bean ${c.roastedBean}   subtle border
  //   crater       ${c.crater}   strong border
  //   crema        ${c.crema}   primary text
  //   bone         ${c.bone}   reading text
  //   mocha        ${c.mocha}   secondary text
  //   structural   ${p.structural}   punctuation / inactive chrome
  //   amber        ${c.amber}   accent
  //   teal         ${c.teal}   functions / links / live
  //   gold         ${c.gold}   types
  //   sage         ${p.sage}   strings
  //   slate        ${p.slate}   SDK symbols / data keys
  //   mauve        ${p.mauve}   keywords / markup
  //   scarlet      ${c.scarlet}   invalid syntax / errors only`;
  let result = renameTheme(replaceColors(source, colorMapFor(variant)), variant);
  result = result
    .replace('// Version: 4.0.0', '// Version: 5.1.0 companion')
    .replace(/\/\/ Philosophy: 12-hour-shift optimization\.[\s\S]*?\/\/ between functions \(slate\) and types \(gold\) makes code scannable without conscious effort\./,
      `// Philosophy: OLED-aware warm surfaces with calibrated foreground contrast for ordinary room light.\n  // Teal marks user-code functions; slate is reserved for SDK/default-library symbols; gold marks types.`)
    .replaceAll('selection uses amber at 27% opacity', 'selection uses amber at 15% opacity')
    .replace(/\/\/ slate: functions are (?:the )?verbs\.[^\n]*/, '// teal: user-code functions are kinetic; slate is reserved for SDK/default-library symbols.')
    .replace('// scarlet tags: HTML has fewer keywords than code, so scarlet is appropriate here.', '// mauve tags: markup is structural; scarlet remains reserved for invalid/error states.')
    .replace('— scarlet for attention', '— amber-hot for semantic caution')
    .replace('errors / HTML tags / escape chars', 'invalid syntax / errors only')
    .replace('functions / JSON keys / CSS props', 'SDK symbols / JSON keys / CSS props')
    .replace(/  \/\/ Palette quick reference:[\s\S]*?\n  \/\/ NOTE:/, `${paletteHeader}\n  // NOTE:`);

  // Remove/repair legacy no-op keys; modern roles below use the current registry.
  result = result
    .replace(/^\s*"minimap\.foreground"[^\n]*\n/m, '')
    .replace(/^\s*"editorFoldIcon\.foreground"[^\n]*\n/m, '')
    .replace(/^\s*"notification\.(?:background|foreground|border)"[^\n]*\n/gm, '');

  const workbench = {
    foreground: c.bone,
    descriptionForeground: c.mocha,
    disabledForeground: `${c.asparagus}CC`,
    'icon.foreground': c.mocha,
    'editor.foreground': c.bone,
    'selection.background': `${c.amber}26`,
    'editor.selectionBackground': `${c.amber}26`,
    'editor.selectionForeground': c.crema,
    'editor.selectionHighlightBackground': `${c.amber}1A`,
    'editor.inactiveSelectionBackground': `${c.amber}1A`,
    'editor.findMatchBackground': `${c.amber}26`,
    'editor.findMatchHighlightBackground': `${c.amber}14`,
    'editor.findMatchBorder': c.amber,
    'editor.wordHighlightBackground': `${c.teal}1A`,
    'editor.wordHighlightStrongBackground': `${c.teal}26`,
    'editorLineNumber.foreground': p.structural,
    'editorLineNumber.dimmedForeground': p.structural,
    'editorGutter.foldingControlForeground': p.structural,
    'editorCodeLens.foreground': p.structural,
    'editorGhostText.foreground': c.asparagus,
    'editorInlayHint.foreground': p.structural,
    'activityBar.inactiveForeground': p.structural,
    'titleBar.inactiveForeground': p.structural,
    'tab.inactiveForeground': p.structural,
    'tab.unfocusedInactiveForeground': p.structural,
    'panelTitle.inactiveForeground': p.structural,
    'input.placeholderForeground': p.structural,
    'breadcrumb.foreground': p.structural,
    'list.deemphasizedForeground': p.structural,
    'commandCenter.inactiveForeground': p.structural,
    'diffEditor.unchangedRegionForeground': p.structural,
    'gitDecoration.ignoredResourceForeground': p.structural,
    'debugIcon.breakpointDisabledForeground': p.structural,
    'editor.inlineValuesForeground': p.structural,
    'inlineChatInput.placeholderForeground': p.structural,
    'terminal.ansiBrightBlack': p.structural,
    'terminal.ansiBrightRed': p.scarletBright,
    'terminal.ansiBrightGreen': p.sageBright,
    'terminal.ansiBrightBlue': p.slateBright,
    'terminal.ansiBrightMagenta': p.mauveBright,
    'terminal.ansiBrightCyan': p.tealBright,
    'statusBarItem.remoteHoverBackground': p.tealActive,
  };
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(workbench)) result = setJsoncValue(result, key, value);

  const semantic = {
    function: c.teal,
    'function.declaration': c.teal,
    method: c.teal,
    'method.declaration': c.teal,
    member: c.teal,
    'function.defaultLibrary': { foreground: p.slate, italic: true },
    'method.defaultLibrary': { foreground: p.slate, italic: true },
    'variable.defaultLibrary': { foreground: p.slate, italic: true },
    unreachableCode: { foreground: p.structural, strikethrough: true },
    deprecated: { foreground: c.amberHot, strikethrough: true },
  };
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(semantic)) result = setJsoncValue(result, key, value);

  const namedRules = [
    ['String — escape sequence', c.amberHot],
    ['Function — declaration name', c.teal],
    ['Function — call', c.teal],
    ['Method — declaration and call', c.teal],
    ['Variable — predefined / built-in', p.slate, 'italic'],
    ['Python — built-in function', p.slate, 'italic'],
    ['CSS — function', p.slate],
    ['Shell — command name', c.teal],
    ['Punctuation — general', p.structural],
    ['Punctuation — tag angle brackets', p.structural],
    ['JSX/TSX — HTML tag', p.mauve],
    ['HTML — tag name', p.mauve],
    ['HTML — tag punctuation', p.structural],
    ['Markdown — link brackets', p.structural],
    ['Markdown — horizontal rule', p.structural],
    ['Markdown — strikethrough', p.structural, 'strikethrough'],
    ['Go — blank identifier', p.structural],
    ['Deprecated — visually dying', c.amberHot, 'italic strikethrough'],
  ];
  for (const [name, foreground, style] of namedRules) result = setNamedRule(result, name, foreground, style);
  result = result
    .replace(
      '        "meta.function-call entity.name.function",\n        "support.function",\n        "support.function.builtin"',
      '        "meta.function-call entity.name.function"',
    )
    .replace(
      '        "meta.method entity.name.function",\n        "support.function.member"',
      '        "meta.method entity.name.function"',
    )
    .replace(
      /\n  \]\n}\s*$/,
      `,
    {
      "name": "Function — SDK / built-in support",
      "scope": [
        "support.function",
        "support.function.builtin",
        "support.function.member"
      ],
      "settings": { "foreground": "${p.slate}", "fontStyle": "italic" }
    }
  ]
}
`,
    );
  result = addModernVsCodeRoles(result, variant);
  return `${JS_BANNER}\n${normalizePlatformNarrative(result, variant)}`;
}

function nearestMappedColor(value, map, maxDelta = 3) {
  const [r, g, b] = rgb(value);
  let best = null;
  for (const [from, to] of map.entries()) {
    const [fr, fg, fb] = rgb(from);
    const delta = Math.max(Math.abs(r - fr), Math.abs(g - fg), Math.abs(b - fb));
    if (!best || delta < best.delta) best = { delta, to };
  }
  return best && best.delta <= maxDelta ? best.to : null;
}

function rewriteXcodeFloatColors(source, map) {
  return source.replace(/<string>([0-9]*\.?[0-9]+)\s+([0-9]*\.?[0-9]+)\s+([0-9]*\.?[0-9]+)\s+([0-9]*\.?[0-9]+)<\/string>/g, (match, r, g, b, a) => {
    if (Number(a) !== 1) return match;
    const current = hexFromRgb(Number(r) * 255, Number(g) * 255, Number(b) * 255);
    const replacement = map.get(current) || nearestMappedColor(current, map);
    if (!replacement) return match;
    return `<string>${rgb(replacement).map((v) => (v / 255).toFixed(3)).join(' ')} 1</string>`;
  });
}

function rewriteITermFloatColors(source, map) {
  const pattern = /(<key>Blue Component<\/key>\s*<real>)([0-9.]+)(<\/real>\s*<key>Color Space<\/key>\s*<string>[^<]+<\/string>\s*<key>Green Component<\/key>\s*<real>)([0-9.]+)(<\/real>\s*<key>Red Component<\/key>\s*<real>)([0-9.]+)(<\/real>)/g;
  return source.replace(pattern, (match, p1, b, p2, g, p3, r, p4) => {
    const current = hexFromRgb(Number(r) * 255, Number(g) * 255, Number(b) * 255);
    const replacement = map.get(current) || nearestMappedColor(current, map);
    if (!replacement) return match;
    const [nr, ng, nb] = rgb(replacement).map((v) => (v / 255).toFixed(9));
    return `${p1}${nb}${p2}${ng}${p3}${nr}${p4}`;
  });
}

function sanitizeXmlComments(source) {
  return source.replace(/<!--([\s\S]*?)-->/g, (_, body) => `<!--${body.replaceAll('--', '—') }-->`);
}

function addXmlBanner(source) {
  return source.replace(/^(<\?xml[^>]+\?>)/, `$1\n${XML_BANNER}`);
}

function addScriptBanner(source) {
  return source.startsWith('#!') ? source.replace(/^(#![^\n]+\n)/, `$1${HASH_BANNER}\n`) : `${HASH_BANNER}\n${source}`;
}

function buildThemeModule(variant) {
  const c = variant.colors;
  const p = variant.platform;
  const roles = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(base.roles).filter(([key]) => !key.startsWith('_')).map(([key, token]) => [key, c[token]]));
  const ansi = {
    normal: [c.obsidian, c.scarlet, p.sage, c.amber, p.slate, p.mauve, c.teal, c.bone],
    bright: [p.structural, p.scarletBright, p.sageBright, c.gold, p.slateBright, p.mauveBright, p.tealBright, c.crema],
  };
  const semantic = {
    background: { canvas: c.void, surface: c.obsidian, elevated: c.darkCacao, panel: c.espresso, interactive: c.espressoHover },
    foreground: { primary: c.crema, reading: c.bone, secondary: c.mocha, tertiary: c.asparagus, structural: p.structural, inverse: c.void },
    border: { subtle: c.roastedBean, default: c.craterDeep, strong: c.crater, focus: c.teal },
    severity: { critical: c.scarlet, worsening: c.magenta, improving: c.harvest, stable: c.olive, resolved: c.teal },
    status: { ready: c.gold, live: c.teal, warning: c.brass, error: c.burntSienna },
  };
  return `${JS_BANNER}
export const metadata = Object.freeze(${JSON.stringify({ id: variant.id, displayOrder: variant.displayOrder, name: variant.name, selector: variant.selector, className: variant.className, description: variant.description, intent: variant.intent }, null, 2)});
export const colors = Object.freeze(${JSON.stringify(c, null, 2)});
export const roles = Object.freeze(${JSON.stringify(roles, null, 2)});
export const syntax = Object.freeze(${JSON.stringify({ structural: p.structural, sage: p.sage, slate: p.slate, mauve: p.mauve }, null, 2)});
export const ansi = Object.freeze(${JSON.stringify(ansi, null, 2)});
export const semantic = Object.freeze(${JSON.stringify(semantic, null, 2)});

const theme = Object.freeze({ metadata, colors, roles, syntax, ansi, semantic });
export default theme;
`;
}

function buildSwiftFamily() {
  const all = [{
    id: 'black-label',
    name: 'Dark Roast: Black Label',
    colors: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(base.colors).filter(([key]) => !key.startsWith('_'))),
    platform: { ...basePlatform, structural: base.colors.crater },
  }, ...variants.filter((variant) => !Array.isArray(variant.targets) || variant.targets.includes('native'))];
  const fields = [...Object.keys(all[0].colors), 'structural', 'sage', 'slate', 'mauve'];
  const cases = all.map((theme) => `    case ${theme.id === 'black-label' ? 'blackLabel' : theme.id.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, c) => c.toUpperCase())} = "${theme.id}"`).join('\n');
  const palettes = all.map((theme) => {
    const caseName = theme.id === 'black-label' ? 'blackLabel' : theme.id.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, c) => c.toUpperCase());
    const values = fields.map((field) => {
      const value = theme.colors[field] || theme.platform[field];
      return `            ${field === 'void' ? 'void_' : field}: drColor(0x${value.slice(1)})`;
    }).join(',\n');
    return `        case .${caseName}:\n            return DarkRoastPalette(\n${values}\n            )`;
  }).join('\n');
  const declarations = fields.map((field) => `    public let ${field === 'void' ? 'void_' : field}: Color`).join('\n');
  return `${JS_BANNER.replace('//', '//')}
import SwiftUI

/// Additive, side-by-side Dark Roast palettes. The legacy DarkRoast API remains unchanged.
public enum DarkRoastThemeVariant: String, CaseIterable, Identifiable {
${cases}

    public var id: String { rawValue }

    public var palette: DarkRoastPalette {
        switch self {
${palettes}
        }
    }
}

public struct DarkRoastPalette {
${declarations}
}

private struct DarkRoastPaletteKey: EnvironmentKey {
    static let defaultValue = DarkRoastThemeVariant.blackLabel.palette
}

public extension EnvironmentValues {
    /// The selected additive Dark Roast palette. This does not replace the
    /// legacy darkRoastTheme value from EnhancedDarkRoastTheme.
    var darkRoastPalette: DarkRoastPalette {
        get { self[DarkRoastPaletteKey.self] }
        set { self[DarkRoastPaletteKey.self] = newValue }
    }
}

public extension View {
    /// Select a Dark Roast family palette for this view hierarchy.
    func darkRoastPalette(_ variant: DarkRoastThemeVariant) -> some View {
        environment(\\.darkRoastPalette, variant.palette)
    }
}

private func drColor(_ hex: UInt32) -> Color {
    Color(
        .sRGB,
        red: Double((hex >> 16) & 0xFF) / 255,
        green: Double((hex >> 8) & 0xFF) / 255,
        blue: Double(hex & 0xFF) / 255,
        opacity: 1
    )
}
`;
}

function assertVariantPin(variant) {
  if (variant.baseVersion !== base.version || variant.baseFingerprint !== baseFingerprint) {
    throw new Error(`${variant.id}: base pin does not match src/tokens.json; review the companion before updating its fingerprint`);
  }
}

const baseStandaloneCss = readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'dist', 'css', 'dark-roast.css'), 'utf8');
const baseScopedCss = readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'dist', 'css', 'dark-roast-scoped.css'), 'utf8');
const vscodeSource = readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'vscode', 'themes', 'dark-roast-color-theme.json'), 'utf8');
const warpSource = readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'warp', 'dark-roast.yaml'), 'utf8');

for (const variant of variants) {
  assertVariantPin(variant);
  const idPascal = pascal(variant.id);

  effectiveTokens.themeName = variant.name;
  effectiveTokens.version = packageVersion;
  effectiveTokens.status = 'COMPANION';
  effectiveTokens.variant = {
    id: variant.id,
    displayOrder: variant.displayOrder,
    selector: variant.selector,
    polarity: variant.polarity || 'dark',
    targets: variantTargets(variant),
    baseTheme: base.themeName,
    baseVersion: variant.baseVersion,
    baseFingerprint: variant.baseFingerprint,
    intent: variant.intent,
    platform: variant.platform,
  };
  effectiveTokens.colors = { ...effectiveTokens.colors, ...variant.colors };
  effectiveTokens.colors._severityHues = 'Companion-tuned severity hues remain deliberately distinct; validate exact separation with scripts/validate-themes.js.';
  const contrastTargets = effectiveTokens.accessibility.contrastTargets;
  contrastTargets.display.actualVsVoid = contrast(variant.colors.crema, variant.colors.void);
  contrastTargets.workhorse.actualVsVoid = contrast(variant.colors.bone, variant.colors.void);
  contrastTargets.secondary.actualVsVoid = contrast(variant.colors.mocha, variant.colors.void);
  contrastTargets.tertiary.actualVsVoid = contrast(variant.colors.asparagus, variant.colors.void);
  contrastTargets.accent.actualVsVoid = contrast(variant.colors.amber, variant.colors.void);
  delete contrastTargets.secondary.note;
  delete contrastTargets.tertiary.note;
  effectiveTokens.accessibility.assignedSurfaceValidation = {
    surface: variant.quality.contrastSurface,
    minimum: variant.quality.minimumInformationalContrast,
    secondary: contrast(variant.colors.mocha, variant.colors[variant.quality.contrastSurface]),
    tertiary: contrast(variant.colors.asparagus, variant.colors[variant.quality.contrastSurface]),
    structural: contrast(variant.platform.structural, variant.colors[variant.quality.contrastSurface]),
  };
  effectiveTokens.printExport = {
    _note: 'Dark Roast companion palettes are screen themes. Use a dedicated light/print palette instead of inferred color substitution.',
    supported: false,
    rules: [
      'Do not print screen-theme colors directly on a light substrate.',
      'Preserve severity meaning with labels and iconography in every export.',
    ],
  };
  effectiveTokens.oledScience = {
    status: 'unmeasured',
    rationale: 'Companion surfaces are intentionally lighter than Black Label; no device-specific pixel wake-time measurement is inherited.',
  };

  outputs.push([join(ROOT, 'dist', 'css', `dark-roast-${variant.id}.css`), buildCssVariant(baseStandaloneCss, variant, false)]);
  outputs.push([join(ROOT, 'dist', 'css', `dark-roast-${variant.id}-scoped.css`), buildCssVariant(baseScopedCss, variant, true)]);
  outputs.push([join(ROOT, 'dist', 'themes', variant.id, 'index.js'), buildThemeModule(variant)]);
  outputs.push([join(ROOT, 'dist', 'themes', variant.id, 'tokens.json'), JSON.stringify(effectiveTokens, null, 2) + '\n']);
  pushIf(hasTarget(variant, 'editor'), [join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'vscode', 'themes', `dark-roast-${variant.id}-color-theme.json`), buildVsCodeVariant(vscodeSource, variant)]);

  const terminalMap = colorMapFor(variant, true);
  pushIf(hasTarget(variant, 'terminal'), [join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'warp', `dark-roast-${variant.id}.yaml`), `${HASH_BANNER}\n${normalizePlatformNarrative(renameTheme(replaceColors(warpSource, terminalMap), variant), variant)}`]);
  pushIf(hasTarget(variant, 'terminal'), [join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'tabby', `dark-roast-${variant.id}.yaml`), `${HASH_BANNER}\n${normalizePlatformNarrative(renameTheme(replaceColors(tabbySource, terminalMap), variant), variant)}`]);

  let textastic = renameTheme(replaceColors(textasticSource, colorMapFor(variant)), variant)
    .replace('23707EF3-1F96-43C3-946F-4DFFA64AF02C', variant.textasticUuid)
    .replace('theme.dark.dark-roast', `theme.dark.${variant.selector}`)
    .replace(
      '        meta.function-call.generic, variable.function,\n        support.function.call, meta.method-call',
      '        meta.function-call.generic, variable.function, meta.method-call',
    );
  const tmRules = [
    ['String — Escape Sequence', variant.colors.amberHot],
    ['Function — Declaration Name', variant.colors.teal],
    ['Function — Call / Invocation', variant.colors.teal],
    ['Function — Built-in / Support', variant.platform.slate, 'italic'],
    ['Function — Constructor', variant.colors.gold],
    ['HTML / XML — Tag Name', variant.platform.mauve],
    ['HTML / XML — Tag Punctuation', variant.platform.structural],
    ['Punctuation — Separator / Terminator', variant.platform.structural],
    ['Punctuation — Braces / Brackets / Parens', variant.platform.structural],
    ['Invalid — Deprecated', variant.colors.amberHot, 'italic strikethrough'],
  ];
  for (const [name, foreground, style] of tmRules) textastic = setTmThemeRule(textastic, name, foreground, style);
  textastic = normalizeTextasticCompanionComments(textastic, variant);
  pushIf(hasTarget(variant, 'editor'), [join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'textastic', `Dark-Roast-${idPascal.replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, '$1-$2')}.tmTheme`), addXmlBanner(textastic)]);

  let xcode = renameTheme(replaceHexColors(xcodeSource, colorMapFor(variant)), variant);
  xcode = sanitizeXmlComments(normalizePlatformNarrative(rewriteXcodeFloatColors(xcode, colorMapFor(variant)), variant));
  pushIf(hasTarget(variant, 'editor'), [join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'xcode', `Dark Roast ${variant.shortName}.dvtcolortheme`), addXmlBanner(xcode)]);

  let iterm = renameTheme(replaceHexColors(itermSource, terminalMap), variant);
  iterm = sanitizeXmlComments(normalizePlatformNarrative(rewriteITermFloatColors(iterm, terminalMap), variant));
  iterm = iterm.replaceAll(`"${variant.name}"`, `"${variant.name.replace(':', '')}"`);
  pushIf(hasTarget(variant, 'terminal'), [join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'iterm2', `Dark Roast ${variant.shortName}.itermcolors`), addXmlBanner(iterm)]);

  // Blink names an imported theme after its file, and the const identifier is
  // cosmetic but should read as the companion rather than the base palette.
  let blink = renameTheme(replaceColors(blinkSource, terminalMap), variant)
    .replaceAll('"platforms/blink/Dark Roast.js"', `"platforms/blink/Dark Roast ${variant.shortName}.js"`)
    .replaceAll('select "Dark Roast"', `select "Dark Roast ${variant.shortName}"`)
    .replaceAll('darkRoast', `darkRoast${pascal(variant.id)}`);
  blink = normalizePlatformNarrative(blink, variant);
  pushIf(hasTarget(variant, 'terminal'), [join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'blink', `Dark Roast ${variant.shortName}.js`), `${JS_BANNER}\n${blink}`]);

  let terminal = renameTheme(replaceColors(terminalSource, terminalMap), variant)
    .replaceAll('generate-terminal-profile.py', `generate-${variant.id}-profile.py`)
    .replaceAll('Dark Roast.itermcolors', `Dark Roast ${variant.shortName}.itermcolors`);
  terminal = normalizePlatformNarrative(terminal, variant);
  terminal = terminal
    .replace(
      'from Foundation import NSColor, NSKeyedArchiver, NSData\n    from AppKit import NSFont',
      'from Foundation import NSKeyedArchiver\n    from AppKit import NSColor, NSFont',
    )

      '\ndef color_to_nsdata(hex_color):',
      `\ndef archive_nsobject(value):
    """Archive an AppKit object and surface any NSError returned by PyObjC."""
    result = NSKeyedArchiver.archivedDataWithRootObject_requiringSecureCoding_error_(
        value, False, None
    )
    if isinstance(result, tuple):
        data, error = result
    else:
        data, error = result, None
    if data is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"NSKeyedArchiver failed: {error}")
    return bytes(data)


def color_to_nsdata(hex_color):`,
    )
    .replace(
      `    # Archive it using NSKeyedArchiver
    data = NSKeyedArchiver.archivedDataWithRootObject_requiringSecureCoding_error_(
        color, False, None
    )
    # data is NSData; convert to Python bytes for plistlib
    return bytes(data)`,
      '    return archive_nsobject(color)',
    )
    .replace(
      `    data = NSKeyedArchiver.archivedDataWithRootObject_requiringSecureCoding_error_(
        font, False, None
    )
    return bytes(data)`,
      '    return archive_nsobject(font)',
    );
  pushIf(hasTarget(variant, 'terminal'), [join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'terminal-app', `generate-${variant.id}-profile.py`), addScriptBanner(terminal)]);
}

${variants.map((variant) => `export { default as ${variant.id.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, c) => c.toUpperCase())} } from './${variant.id}/index.js';`).join('\n')}
`;

  companions: variants.map((variant) => ({
    id: variant.id,

    name: variant.name,

// Renaming or removing a companion must not leave an old generated theme in
// the npm package. Expected-file drift alone cannot catch extra paths, so scan
// every generator-owned output area for our banner (plus companion token JSON)
// and either reject or prune unexpected artifacts.
const ownedOutputRoots = [
  join(ROOT, 'dist', 'css'),
  join(ROOT, 'dist', 'themes'),
  join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'vscode', 'themes'),
  join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'warp'),
  join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'tabby'),
  join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'textastic'),
  join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'xcode'),
  join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'iterm2'),
  join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'blink'),
  join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'terminal-app'),
  join(ROOT, 'platforms', 'swift'),
];

function walkFiles(directory) {
  let entries;
  try { entries = readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true }); } catch { return []; }
  return entries.flatMap((entry) => {
    const path = join(directory, entry.name);
    return entry.isDirectory() ? walkFiles(path) : [path];
  });
}

function isOwnedGeneratedArtifact(path) {
  let content;
  try { content = readFileSync(path, 'utf8'); } catch { return false; }
  if (content.slice(0, 180).includes('AUTO-GENERATED by scripts/build-variants.js')) return true;
  if (path.endsWith('.json') && path.includes(join('dist', 'themes'))) {
    try {
      const value = JSON.parse(content);
      const companionTokens = value?.status === 'COMPANION' && typeof value?.variant?.id === 'string';
      const familyManifest = value?.base?.id === 'black-label' && Array.isArray(value?.companions);
      return companionTokens || familyManifest;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

function pruneEmptySubdirectories(directory) {
  let entries;
  try { entries = readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true }); } catch { return; }
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (!entry.isDirectory()) continue;
    const path = join(directory, entry.name);
    pruneEmptySubdirectories(path);
    try {
      if (readdirSync(path).length === 0) rmdirSync(path);
    } catch {}
  }
}

const expectedPaths = new Set(outputs.map(([path]) => path));
const unexpectedPaths = [...new Set(ownedOutputRoots.flatMap(walkFiles))]
  .filter((path) => !expectedPaths.has(path) && isOwnedGeneratedArtifact(path));

let stale = 0;
for (const path of unexpectedPaths) {
  if (check) {
    stale++;
    console.error(`✗ unexpected generated artifact: ${path.replace(ROOT + '/', '')}`);
  } else {
    rmSync(path);
    console.log(`✓ pruned ${path.replace(ROOT + '/', '')}`);
  }
}
if (!check) {
  pruneEmptySubdirectories(join(ROOT, 'dist', 'themes'));
}

for (const [path, content] of outputs) {
  let current = null;
  try { current = readFileSync(path, 'utf8'); } catch {}
  if (check) {
    if (current !== content) {
      stale++;
      console.error(`✗ stale: ${path.replace(ROOT + '/', '')}`);
    }
  } else {
    mkdirSync(dirname(path), { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(path, content);
    console.log(`✓ wrote ${path.replace(ROOT + '/', '')}`);
  }
}

if (check) {
  if (stale) {
    console.error(`\n${stale} companion file(s) out of sync. Run \`npm run build:variants\`.`);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log(`✓ ${outputs.length} companion files in sync; Black Label source untouched`);
}


===== FILE: dark-roast-theme/scripts/check-black-label-contract.js =====
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Guard the user's explicit product boundary: companions are additive and the
// established Black Label files do not move incidentally.

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const ROOT = join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');
const fixture = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(ROOT, 'src', 'black-label-contract.json'), 'utf8'));
const failures = [];

for (const [relativePath, expected] of Object.entries(fixture.sha256)) {
  let bytes;
  try {
    bytes = readFileSync(join(ROOT, relativePath));
  } catch (error) {
    failures.push(`${relativePath}: ${error.code === 'ENOENT' ? 'missing' : error.message}`);
    continue;
  }
  const actual = createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
  if (actual !== expected) failures.push(`${relativePath}: expected ${expected}, got ${actual}`);
}

if (failures.length) {
  console.error(`FAIL Black Label contract (${failures.length} changed file${failures.length === 1 ? '' : 's'})`);
  for (const failure of failures) console.error(`  - ${failure}`);
  console.error('Black Label changes require an explicit product decision; do not refresh this fixture for companion work.');
  process.exit(1);
}

console.log(`PASS Black Label contract: ${Object.keys(fixture.sha256).length} canonical files unchanged from ${fixture.lockedAt}`);
