      var compactQuery = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1120px)');
      var preferredMode = 'side';
      var activePointer = null;

      function normalizeColor(color) {
        var probe = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d');
        probe.fillStyle = color;
        var normalized = probe.fillStyle;
        if (normalized.charAt(0) === '#') {
          if (normalized.length === 4) {
            normalized = '#' + normalized[1] + normalized[1] + normalized[2] + normalized[2] + normalized[3] + normalized[3];
          }
          return normalized.toUpperCase();
        }
        var parts = normalized.match(/\d+/g);
        if (!parts || parts.length < 3) return color.trim();
        return '#' + parts.slice(0, 3).map(function (part) {
          return Number(part).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
        }).join('').toUpperCase();
      }

      function luminance(hex) {
        var value = hex.replace('#', '');
        var channels = [0, 2, 4].map(function (index) {
          var channel = parseInt(value.slice(index, index + 2), 16) / 255;
          return channel <= 0.04045 ? channel / 12.92 : Math.pow((channel + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
        });
        return 0.2126 * channels[0] + 0.7152 * channels[1] + 0.0722 * channels[2];
      }

      function themeColor(element, property) {
        return normalizeColor(getComputedStyle(element).getPropertyValue(property).trim());
      }

      var baselineHex = themeColor(document.querySelector('[data-theme-row="dark-roast"]'), '--dr-void');
      var baselineLuminance = luminance(baselineHex);

      document.querySelectorAll('[data-theme-row]').forEach(function (row) {
        var canvasHex = themeColor(row, '--dr-void');
        var ratio = luminance(canvasHex) / baselineLuminance;
        var lift = row.dataset.themeRow === 'dark-roast' ? 'Canvas baseline · ' + canvasHex : ratio.toFixed(1) + '× canvas luminance · ' + canvasHex;
        row.querySelector('[data-lift]').textContent = lift;

        var paletteGrid = row.querySelector('[data-palette-grid]');
        paletteTokens.forEach(function (token) {
          var tile = document.createElement('div');
          var label = document.createElement('span');
          var name = document.createElement('b');
          var hex = document.createElement('span');
          var color = themeColor(row, token.property);
          tile.className = 'palette-tile';
          tile.style.setProperty('--tile', 'var(' + token.property + ')');
          tile.dataset.proofToken = token.property;
          tile.title = token.label + ' ' + color;
          label.className = 'tile-label';
          name.textContent = token.label;
          hex.textContent = color;
          label.append(name, hex);
          tile.append(label);
          paletteGrid.append(tile);
        });

        row.querySelectorAll('.surface-rail span').forEach(function (cell, index) {
          var token = surfaceTokens[index];
          cell.title = token.label + ' ' + themeColor(row, token.property);
        });
      });

      function updatePreview(side, themeId) {
        var preview = document.querySelector('[data-preview="' + side + '"]');
        var host = hosts[side];
        var meta = themes[themeId];
        host.dataset.theme = themeId;
        preview.querySelector('[data-preview-title]').textContent = meta.name;
        var canvas = themeColor(host, '--dr-void');
        var ratio = luminance(canvas) / baselineLuminance;
        preview.querySelector('[data-preview-canvas]').textContent = canvas;
        preview.querySelector('[data-preview-lift]').textContent = themeId === 'dark-roast' ? 'baseline' : ratio.toFixed(1) + '× light';
        document.querySelector('[data-wipe-label="' + side + '"]').textContent = meta.name;
      }

      function syncPresets() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.preset-button').forEach(function (button) {
          var active = button.dataset.left === leftSelect.value && button.dataset.right === rightSelect.value;
          button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
        });
      }

      function announce() {
        status.textContent = themes[leftSelect.value].name + ' on the left and ' + themes[rightSelect.value].name + ' on the right, shown ' + (stage.dataset.mode === 'wipe' ? 'with a movable wipe divider.' : 'side by side.');
      }

      function syncThemes(shouldAnnounce) {
        updatePreview('left', leftSelect.value);
        updatePreview('right', rightSelect.value);
        syncPresets();
        if (shouldAnnounce) announce();
      }

      function setMode(mode, shouldAnnounce) {
        stage.dataset.mode = mode;
        document.querySelectorAll('.mode-button').forEach(function (button) {
          button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(button.dataset.mode === mode));
        });
        if (shouldAnnounce) announce();
      }

      controls.addEventListener('submit', function (event) { event.preventDefault(); });
      leftSelect.addEventListener('change', function () { syncThemes(true); });
      rightSelect.addEventListener('change', function () { syncThemes(true); });

      document.getElementById('swap-themes').addEventListener('click', function () {
        var left = leftSelect.value;
        leftSelect.value = rightSelect.value;
        rightSelect.value = left;
        syncThemes(true);
      });

      document.querySelectorAll('.preset-button').forEach(function (button) {
        button.addEventListener('click', function () {
          leftSelect.value = button.dataset.left;
          rightSelect.value = button.dataset.right;
          syncThemes(true);
        });
      });

      document.querySelectorAll('.mode-button').forEach(function (button) {
        button.addEventListener('click', function () {
          preferredMode = button.dataset.mode;
          setMode(compactQuery.matches ? 'wipe' : preferredMode, true);
        });
      });

      function setWipePosition(value) {
        var clamped = Math.max(10, Math.min(90, Math.round(value)));
        wipeInput.value = String(clamped);
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--wipe', clamped + '%');
      }

      function setWipeFromPointer(event) {
        var bounds = stage.querySelector('.stage-canvas').getBoundingClientRect();
        setWipePosition(((event.clientX - bounds.left) / bounds.width) * 100);
      }

      wipeInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
        setWipePosition(Number(wipeInput.value));
      });

      wipeDivider.addEventListener('pointerdown', function (event) {
        activePointer = event.pointerId;
        wipeDivider.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
        setWipeFromPointer(event);
        event.preventDefault();
      });

      wipeDivider.addEventListener('pointermove', function (event) {
        if (event.pointerId !== activePointer) return;
        setWipeFromPointer(event);
      });

      function releaseWipePointer(event) {
        if (event.pointerId !== activePointer) return;
        activePointer = null;
        if (wipeDivider.hasPointerCapture(event.pointerId)) wipeDivider.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
      }

      wipeDivider.addEventListener('pointerup', releaseWipePointer);
      wipeDivider.addEventListener('pointercancel', releaseWipePointer);

      function applyResponsiveMode() {
        var mode = compactQuery.matches ? 'wipe' : preferredMode;
        setMode(mode, false);
      }

      [compactQuery].forEach(function (query) {
        if (typeof query.addEventListener === 'function') {
          query.addEventListener('change', applyResponsiveMode);
        } else {
          query.addListener(applyResponsiveMode);
        }
      });

      wipeDivider.addEventListener('dblclick', function () {
        setWipePosition(50);
      });

      syncThemes(false);
      applyResponsiveMode();
    }());
  </script>
</body>
</html>

/* ==========================================================================
   SECTION 16: MIGRATION BRIDGE — terminal-core.css → dark-roast-tokens.css

   This section documents how --dr-* tokens map to existing --term-* tokens
   for incremental migration. Components can be migrated one at a time by
   switching from --term-* to --dr-* references.

   Updated for v4.0.0 surface-scale renames.

   TERMINAL (Phosphor Theatre)            DARK ROAST (Black Label v4)
   ─────────────────────────────          ───────────────────────────
   --term-bg-void:       #0C0B0A    →   --dr-void:           #120C06
   --term-bg-surface:    #13120F    →   --dr-obsidian:       #160E08
   --term-bg-elevated:   #1B1A16    →   --dr-espresso:       #2A1C13   (was --dr-grain)
   --term-bg-header:     #0E0D0B    →   --dr-void:           #120C06
   --term-bg-input:      #17160F    →   --dr-obsidian:       #160E08

   --term-fg-primary:    #E8E4DC    →   --dr-crema:          #FFF7EE   (warmer, higher contrast)
   --term-fg-secondary:  #A09888    →   --dr-mocha:          #8B7355   (more coffee-toned)
   --term-fg-muted:      #8A8278    →   --dr-asparagus:      #465945   (green-shifted tertiary)
   --term-fg-inverse:    #0C0B0A    →   --dr-void:           #120C06

   --term-border-subtle: #1E1C18    →   --dr-crater-deep:    #3C2A21   (was --dr-crater)
   --term-border-default:#2A2720    →   --dr-crater-deep:    #3C2A21
   --term-border-strong: #3A3630    →   --dr-crater:         #4D3B31   (was --dr-crater-lt)
   --term-border-new:    —          →   --dr-roasted-bean:   #3C2A1E   (new tier)

   --term-accent:        #00FFD0    →   --dr-teal:           #4CC4B4   (less saturated, easier on eyes)
                                    or   --dr-amber:          #E69A4C   (primary accent, not live data)
   --term-gold:          #D4A857    →   --dr-gold:           #DAA520   (slightly more saturated)

   --term-severity-critical:  #EF4444  →  --dr-severity-critical:   #C44C4C
   --term-severity-worsening: #FFAA00  →  --dr-severity-worsening:  #D2691E
   --term-severity-stable:    #00FFD0  →  --dr-severity-stable:     #DAA520
   --term-severity-improving: #4488FF  →  --dr-severity-improving:  #E69A4C
                                          --dr-severity-resolved:   #4CC4B4  (new)

   --term-glow-accent         →  --dr-glow-teal
   --term-glow-gold           →  --dr-glow-amber
   --term-glow-error          →  --dr-glow-scarlet

   --term-font-mono           →  --dr-font-mono       (Fira Code)
   --term-font-display        →  --dr-font-display    (Playfair Display)
   --term-font-body           →  --dr-font-body       (DM Sans)
   (no equivalent)            →  --dr-font-heading    (Instrument Sans — new tier)

   MIGRATION STRATEGY (ORGANIC — 2026-02-25):
   The terminal theme (--term-*) is NOT being abandoned. It remains the
   production baseline for all existing surfaces. Dark Roast (--dr-*) is
   adopted organically: new components and high-value UX reworks use --dr-*
   tokens from day one via :root fallback blocks (beachhead pattern).

   v4 additions also available in beachhead:
     --dr-brass / --dr-warning              (warning semantic)
     --dr-burnt-sienna / --dr-error         (error semantic, ANSI red tone)
     --dr-amber-muted / --dr-accent-muted   (Mystic2-parity reader accent)
     Elevation tokens (--dr-elevation-*-shadow/border)
     Z-index scale (--dr-z-*)
     Icon size scale (--dr-icon-*)
     Expanded spacing (--dr-space-0 through --dr-space-24)
   ========================================================================== */
